evidence.claim: CNAS states that the solid rocket motor supply chain is a well-known bottleneck and identifies L3Harris and Northrop Grumman as the two main current SRM suppliers.

NewMarket says its subsidiary AMPAC is a specialty materials manufacturer for U.S. government military and space programs and produces highly technical materials for space launch and military defense applications.

NewMarket announced approval of up to $100 million of AMPAC investment to expand ammonium perchlorate production capabilities in support of growing solid rocket motor demand, adding more than 50% capacity with completion scheduled during 2026.
evidence.source_title: NewMarket Corporation Announces Approval of AMPAC Expansion

evidence.claim: NewMarket’s 2023 10-K states it acquired AMPAC and that AMPAC manufactures and sells critical performance additives used in solid rocket motors for space launch and military defense applications.
Park Aerospace SEC-filed materials state that Park offers specialty ablative materials for rocket motors and nozzles and supplies advanced composite materials for aircraft and missile systems.
Hexcel’s official Defense and Space page says its advanced composite space applications include solid rocket booster cases, fairings, payload doors, and military/commercial satellite structures.

CNAS states that as recently as 2020 there was only one domestic source certified to provide ammonium perchlorate relied upon by SRM makers, a second company was certified in 2021, and demand still outstrips supply.

memory_update.text: NEU should be promoted as the highest-priority underfollowed Layer 1B candidate for solid rocket motor input exposure because AMPAC directly ties ammonium perchlorate capacity expansion to SRM demand.
PKE is a small-cap subtier materials candidate for rocket motor and nozzle ablatives; survival into later layers requires program/customer evidence and revenue materiality.

HXL is a less pure but plausible mid-cap composite-materials supplier for solid rocket booster cases and defense/space structures; verify incremental SRM-driven demand versus broad aerospace exposure.

The strongest chokepoint framing is not simply more SRM assemblers, but qualified energetic-material and component supply: ammonium perchlorate, ablatives/nozzles, composite cases, and certified defense materials.

Need a separate Layer 1C verification pass for private/non-public bottleneck suppliers, including the second certified ammonium perchlorate source, binder/plasticizer suppliers, nozzle-throat materials, energetic testing, and DoD qualification records.

node: Solid rocket motor inputs and energetic-material supply chain
summary: Layer 1B expands the investable universe around solid rocket motor input bottlenecks. The strongest underfollowed public-market exposure found in this pass is NewMarket via AMPAC, which directly produces ammonium perchlorate-linked specialty materials for solid rocket motors and is expanding capacity. Park Aerospace and Hexcel are plausible subtier materials suppliers tied to rocket motor/nozzle ablatives and composite booster/motor-case materials. L3Harris is retained only as a reference anchor because Aerojet Rocketdyne is one of the two major U.S. solid rocket motor suppliers, but the main discovery lane should focus on subtier materials and certified-input constraints rather than primes.
